episode_title: Podcast 121 | Association Member Experience Trends: Why People Join and Stay
question: Why do association members join and stay according to Forge's State of Association Member Experience Report?
transcript_excerpt: Overwhelmingly across the last five years, the top two reasons why members join and stay are for peer-to-peer connections and for ongoing learning and the opportunity to participate in education. 85% of respondents cite one of those two as the primary reason.

episode_title: Podcast 121 | Association Member Experience Trends: Why People Join and Stay
question: What percentage of association members believe AI could replace what associations provide?
transcript_excerpt: Only 1% of respondents cited that AI could replace what the association provides. This means 99% are saying what the association provides is irreplaceable, though trust in AI-generated content specifically dropped from 31% to 26% year over year.

episode_title: Podcast 121 | Association Member Experience Trends: Why People Join and Stay
question: What percentage of early-career professionals are switching careers when joining associations?
transcript_excerpt: 40% of individuals who identified as early career were actually switching careers, meaning they were early in that field but not young professionals. This dropped to 13% for mid-career and 10% for late career members.

episode_title: Podcast 121 | Association Member Experience Trends: Why People Join and Stay
question: How does trust in AI-generated content change when validated by an expert in associations?
transcript_excerpt: When AI content is validated by an expert, trust goes up to 49%, compared to 26% for AI-generated content without expert validation. The opportunity for associations is to leverage AI but backstop it with their credible expertise.
